messages:
sasha: Noticed a blind spot in daily aggregates for tenant=payments at 2026-03-20T10:00Z — counts are ~55% of expected. dashboard alerted. :confused:
devin: which pipeline? nearline or batch?
sasha: nearline consumer lag spiked; suspect a failed replay for shard-43. logs show a crash but not sure why yet.
nana: pinging storage team? could be a transient S3 5xx we masked.
raghav: quick check: ops-bot shows replayer shard-43 exit code 137 at 2026-03-20T11:02Z (OOM/kill).
ops-bot: Replayer(shard-43) exit: code=137 signal=9 at 2026-03-20T11:02:13. logs: s3://redwood-logs/replayer/shard-43/2026-03-20.log
devin: OK, so late events exist but didn't apply. We should do a targeted replay (not a full recompute). two asks: minimize risk to live traffic & keep quota usage visible in console.
sasha: Plan: 1) run small canary sample 5% to validate apply logic 2) if delta >7% continue to full apply 3) use reserved pool to avoid stealing shared slots 4) warm KV cache after write.
nana: +1. Add an explicit idempotency token and dry-run diff export. We had trouble once where double-apply bumped counters.
raghav: Also: console quota shows daily rehydrate quota at 68%. running on reserved avoids tenant slot quotas but still needs reservation if >20m. estimate full run ~18m on 2xA100.
sasha: I'll open RES-8012 for 2xA100 30m window.
ops-bot: Reservation ticket created RES-8012: 2xA100 reserved 2026-03-21T03:00Z-03:30Z UTC.
devin: Canary command (dry-run):
```
replay-run --hour=2026-03-20T10:00Z --tenant=payments --shard=43 --sample=0.05 --apply=false --idempotency-token=payments-20260320-10-canary
```
raghav: After sample, export diff to s3://redwood-replays/payments/2026-03-20-10-canary-diff.json and compare via dev dashboard query. If sample delta >=7% we escalate to full.
sasha: I'll add a small console flag: payments:2026-03-20T10:00Z -> rehydrate:pending (visible to PMs). quick +1 from product?
nana: product said ok to expose rehydrate flags for internal ops only.
ops-bot: Canary job completed at 2026-03-21T03:07Z. Result: sample delta +8.2% on active_sessions_hourly (tenant=payments). diff stored: s3://redwood-replays/payments/2026-03-20-10-canary-diff.json
devin: +8.2% > 7% threshold. greenlight for full run. add pre/post snapshot and a rollback playbook entry to the ticket.
sasha: Full run command:
```
replay-run --hour=2026-03-20T10:00Z --tenant=payments --shard=43 --apply=true --concurrency=1 --target=reserved --idempotency-token=payments-20260320-10-full
```
raghav: launched. watching apply throughput. we'll stream trace spans to the console.
nana: reminder: run KV-cache-warm after apply: `kv-warm --tenant=payments --hour=2026-03-20T10:00Z --top-keys=5000`
ops-bot: Full replay finished at 2026-03-21T03:17Z. post-apply delta +7.9% (now within expected reconciliation). no write errors; apply latency average 120ms. artifacts: s3://redwood-replays/payments/2026-03-20-10-full-diff.json
devin: nice. follow-up: tweak console to auto-suggest a targeted replay when hourly aggregate drop >20% AND there is a replayer non-zero crash count for that hour. file RFC?
sasha: Filed RFC RI-1309 to add "nearline-rescue" suggestion, plus a console banner and a button to submit a reservation request prefilled with args.
raghav: also adding telemetry: emit a signal rehydrate_suggested with reason fields (drop_pct, crash_count) so we can experiment on automated hints.
nana: let's add a postmortem note: root cause likely OOM due to recent model change increased event payload size. I'll open a follow-up with infra to bump per-shard memory limits.
devin: thanks all. closing thread after RES-8012 updated with run commands and rollback steps. :white_check_mark:
